idea: Una tarde de café y moda en Madrid mostrando tres ángulos diferentes con la misma elegancia.
texto: Madrileña de atardeceres infinitos y café bien cargado. ☕️✨ Entre lienzo y pincel siempre hay hueco para un buen look. Por cierto, ¿cuál es tu plan favorito para desconectar entre semana? 👇
escenas: The same woman, medium shot from the waist up sitting at a wooden table in a cozy Madrid café, wearing an oversized beige knit sweater and delicate gold necklaces, warm afternoon sunlight casting soft shadows, gentle closed-mouth smile looking slightly off-camera

The same woman, upper-body shot leaning slightly forward at the same café table, wearing the same oversized beige knit sweater, warm golden hour lighting from a nearby window, soft expression with lips together looking directly at the camera

The same woman, close-up portrait angled near a whitewashed brick wall inside the same café, wearing the same oversized beige knit sweater, soft natural diffused light, serene look with a subtle smile and eyes sparkling
